Mainnet blocks copied from Zebra's test vectors
(`ZcashFoundation/zebra` v6.3.0, `zebra-test/src/vectors/block-main-*.txt`),
one hex-encoded block per file, named by height. They span v1 (genesis
era), v3 (Overwinter), v4 (Sapling, Blossom, Heartwood, Canopy) and v5
(NU5) transactions. The Merkle root inside each block's own header is the
reference: these blocks are part of the mainnet chain.
